title: On the Log-submodularity for zonoids: from Mixed Volume inequalities to the Hypercube
summary: In convex geometry, a number of inequalities for the volume of coordinate projections of convex bodies share a common structural property. We formalize them as inequalities of log-submodularity type, providing a definition that stems from the notion of a submodular function. The Loomis-Whitney inequality and some of its generalizations are the most prominent examples. Some inequalities of log-submodularity type are valid for zonoids but not for general convex bodies.
